title: The Digital Archive
summary: Numbered entries in the visual essay series. Each is a single documented case, filed with its caption and the note that sits behind it.
note: Archive plates are rendered typographically. The original AI-directed editorial imagery is not bundled with this build.

entries.title: FERAL FEMME — The Product. The Cage.
entries.caption: FF · 01 / 60
entries.lore: A body bound in wire mesh holds the bottle. The bottle is whole. The body is caged. Beauty industry: what is sold to you, and what is paid for that beauty.

entries.title: In the Workshop — Lamp & Shadow
entries.caption: FF · 02 / 60
entries.lore: FERAL FEMME. The atelier portrait. Lit by a single lamp. Caged in wire. The hybrid waits to be witnessed.

entries.title: Gallery — Same Cage, Different Species
entries.caption: FF · 03 / 60
entries.lore: Installation view: wire sculptures of fox, hare, deer. Above them, the FERAL FEMME poster — a hybrid in the same cage. The exhibition itself is the argument.

entries.title: Mirror — Caged, Marked, Awake
entries.caption: FF · 04 / 60
entries.lore: Bathroom mirror. Cage on the head. FERAL written on the cheek. The reflection sees what the world refuses to.

entries.title: Not Your Experiment.
entries.caption: FF · 05 / 60
entries.lore: Two femmes in lab uniforms. Blue solution spilled across the floor. Sign held: NOT YOUR EXPERIMENT. The refusal is editorial.

entries.title: Three Femmes — Lab Triptych
entries.caption: FF · 06 / 60
entries.lore: Three lab-coat femmes in white tile. A FERAL FEMME placard on the table. A cage on the right. The frame contains the entire argument.

entries.title: The Seated — Light Through Bars
entries.caption: FF · 07 / 60
entries.lore: Seated. Composed. The shadow of bars across the body. The cage on the floor empty — for now.

entries.title: Close-Up — The Witness Marked
entries.caption: FF · 08 / 60
entries.lore: Close-up: pale nose, smudged makeup, hybrid ears. Shadow bars fall across the face. The cage is not in the frame. The cage is the frame.

entries.title: Art As Resistance
entries.caption: FF · 09 / 60
entries.lore: Studio. Cracked mirror. Protest signs: ART AS RESISTANCE, CRUELTY-FREE FREE. The artist as witness, painting her own face.

entries.title: The Sticker Wall
entries.caption: FF · 10 / 60
entries.lore: Bathroom mirror covered in stickers. FERAL FEMME printed above the reflection. Beauty products on the counter. Everything caged. Everything sold.

entries.title: Feral Femme Archive — File 7.2-12
entries.caption: FF · 11 / 60
entries.lore: Feral Femme Archive · Editorial · 16.V.2026 · File 7.2-12 · Beauty / Unregulated. Subject F.062 · 1026B. Cruelty classified. Declassified.

entries.title: Same Cage. Different Species.
entries.caption: FF · 12 / 60
entries.lore: Editorial Cover · Issue 05 · "Same cage. Different species." Every "tested" claim ends in the same room. One body wears the cage. The other is the cage.

entries.title: Marked — Property of Industry
entries.caption: FF · 13 / 60
entries.lore: Marked. Numbered. Property of industry. The barcode reads: 6 02569 01345 — a SKU like any other product.

entries.title: The Veiled — Beauty Tested
entries.caption: FF · 14 / 60
entries.lore: Beauty industry: tested on rabbits, mice, guinea pigs. The veil obscures but does not protect. Industry standards across nations not bound by cruelty-free law.

entries.title: The Tank — Cosmetic Testing
entries.caption: FF · 15 / 60
entries.lore: Submerged in the solution being tested. No exit. No consent. No regulation outside EU/UK borders. Beauty Industry · Unregulated · Cosmetic Testing.

entries.title: Crimson — The Body Remembers
entries.caption: FF · 16 / 60
entries.lore: The body remembers what marketing erases. Editorial: scarred, blackened, restrained, witnessed.

entries.title: Paint — One Wears the Cage
entries.caption: FF · 17 / 60
entries.lore: One wears the cage. The other becomes it. Fashion editorial in crimson and black.

entries.title: Seen Through Red — The Filter They Apply
entries.caption: FF · 18 / 60
entries.lore: A red acrylic plate held over a caged face. The industry filters every body through its own colour before it sells it back. FERAL bleeds through anyway.

entries.title: The Grid — Measured For Market
entries.caption: FF · 19 / 60
entries.lore: A wire grid mapped across the face. Every feature plotted, scored, and priced. The word on the cheek refuses the scoring.

entries.title: Crinoline Cage — Couture As Confinement
entries.caption: FF · 20 / 60
entries.lore: Haute couture rendered as containment. The cage is the garment and the garment is the cage. Beauty sold as restraint.

entries.title: Bloom Of Red — The Mark Left Behind
entries.caption: FF · 21 / 60
entries.lore: A red sun bleeds down the concrete. The body stands defiant in the wreckage of what was done to it.

entries.title: Fragile Specimen — Handle As Product
entries.caption: FF · 22 / 60
entries.lore: Boxed, labelled, and shipped. FRAGILE. SPECIMEN. The body reduced to cargo for the industry that purchased it.

entries.title: Calipers — Beauty By The Millimetre
entries.caption: FF · 23 / 60
entries.lore: Gloved hands measure the face to the millimetre. The beauty industry quantifies precisely what it intends to sell.

entries.title: Shrink-Wrapped — Sealed For Sale
entries.caption: FF · 24 / 60
entries.lore: Bound in plastic and wire, packaged like meat. Preserved for a shelf, not for a life.

entries.title: Pinned — FERAL FEMME, Catalogued
entries.caption: FF · 25 / 60
entries.lore: Mounted and pinned like a butterfly under glass. The specimen card reads FERAL FEMME. The collection keeps growing.

entries.title: Caged Heart — The Cost Of Couture
entries.caption: FF · 26 / 60
entries.lore: A wire cage cradles an exposed heart. Fashion that puts the very organ it extracts on display.

entries.title: Redacted — What They Won't Let You See
entries.caption: FF · 27 / 60
entries.lore: A red bar censors the body. The industry decides which parts of you are permitted to be seen.

entries.title: Lattice — Bound In Leather
entries.caption: FF · 28 / 60
entries.lore: A body woven into a leather grid. Crouched, contained, and still watching.

entries.title: The Apparatus — Worn As A Dress
entries.caption: FF · 29 / 60
entries.lore: An industrial cage clamps around lace and corsetry. The machine and the garment become a single restraint.

entries.title: Strung Up — The Body On Wires
entries.caption: FF · 30 / 60
entries.lore: Suspended by steel cable and posed mid-air. A puppet shaped by the industry's hand.

entries.title: Half Mask — The Face They Prefer
entries.caption: FF · 31 / 60
entries.lore: Marionette strings and a glossy black half-mask. Half the face is hidden; the industry sells only the part it likes.

entries.title: The Rig — Held In Place
entries.caption: FF · 32 / 60
entries.lore: Springs and bolts torque around the skull. The specimen held still for inspection in the workshop.

entries.title: Restraint — The Trap Beneath
entries.caption: FF · 33 / 60
entries.lore: Buckled into white restraint with a steel trap waiting below. Compliance demanded, danger guaranteed.

entries.title: The Quiet Specimen — After The Session
entries.caption: FF · 34 / 60
entries.lore: Stripped of apparatus, marked, and kneeling. What remains of a body once the industry sets down its tools.

entries.title: The Pelt — Someone Wore This First
entries.caption: FF · 35 / 60
entries.lore: Draped in spotted fur, slipping off a red heel. The coat had an owner before it was ever a coat.

entries.title: The Footage — Evidence On Loop
entries.caption: FF · 36 / 60
entries.lore: Kneeling before a monitor that replays the muzzle and the scream. The archive refuses to look away.

entries.title: Unicorn Pelt — Selling The Myth
entries.caption: FF · 37 / 60
entries.lore: A creature that never existed, skinned for the runway regardless. The industry will manufacture even the magic it kills.

entries.title: Unicorn Pelt — Profile Of A Trophy
entries.caption: FF · 38 / 60
entries.lore: The horn left intact, the head left empty. Fantasy reduced to a garment and a price tag.

entries.title: Down — Held Before The Harvest
entries.caption: FF · 39 / 60
entries.lore: She cradles the goose whose down fills the coats. Warmth for one body, taken from another.

entries.title: Serpent — Beauty That Constricts
entries.caption: FF · 40 / 60
entries.lore: A pale snake coils across the face. The thing sold as exotic is the thing that tightens.

entries.title: Trinkets — Animals Made Ornamental
entries.caption: FF · 41 / 60
entries.lore: Pets glazed into porcelain charms and strung from a collar. Affection downgraded to accessory.

entries.title: The Herd — A Witness In The Field
entries.caption: FF · 42 / 60
entries.lore: Cheek to cheek with the animal the leather is taken from. The field remembers what the showroom forgets.

entries.title: Holy / Sibal — The Companion Held
entries.caption: FF · 43 / 60
entries.lore: Scarred arms wrap a small cat. The gloves curse and pray at once. FERAL FEMME.

entries.title: Teeth Bared — Protect What's Left
entries.caption: FF · 44 / 60
entries.lore: Teeth to the glove, the cat shielded against the body. A warning to anyone who reaches.

entries.title: Red Bloom — Couture On Ice
entries.caption: FF · 45 / 60
entries.lore: A storm of red ruffles perched on clear acrylic. Beauty that costs the body its footing.

entries.title: Ringed — Marked In Red
entries.caption: FF · 46 / 60
entries.lore: A split-painted face against deep red. Each ring a target, each target a sale.

entries.title: Pleated Wild — Out Past The Studio
entries.caption: FF · 47 / 60
entries.lore: Engineered pleats meet wet moss and bare branches. The specimen returned briefly to the field.

entries.title: The Going Rate — Cash On The Floor
entries.caption: FF · 48 / 60
entries.lore: Perched on worn leather with money scattered beneath. Everyone in the room already knows the price.

entries.title: Boardroom Bloom — Dressed For The Meeting
entries.caption: FF · 49 / 60
entries.lore: Couture ruffles folded into an office chair. The body styled for the people who trade it.

entries.title: Tulle Dusk — The Soft Sell
entries.caption: FF · 50 / 60
entries.lore: Wrapped in clouds of pink and orange tulle. Softness staged to make the cage look gentle.

entries.title: Tulle Storm — Colour As Camouflage
entries.caption: FF · 51 / 60
entries.lore: A crouch inside layered tulle and shadow. The prettier the cloud, the easier to hide the leash.

entries.title: Red Mantle — Seated In Crimson
entries.caption: FF · 52 / 60
entries.lore: Swathed head to boot in red fringe. Dressed as a warning, posed as a want.

entries.title: Backdrop Taped — The Set Exposed
entries.caption: FF · 53 / 60
entries.lore: Mid-motion against a half-taped sweep. The illusion and its scaffolding shown at once.

entries.title: Crimson Brim — The Face Beneath The Fringe
entries.caption: FF · 54 / 60
entries.lore: Red fringe veils the eyes; the painted muzzle stays. Even hidden, the mark shows.

entries.title: Behind The Glass — The Captive’s Stare
entries.caption: FF · 55 / 60
entries.lore: Held behind glass, waiting. The species changes; the room does not.

entries.title: Submerged — Soft Hours In A Hard Room
entries.caption: FF · 56 / 60
entries.lore: Eyes closed against green tile. Rooms like this aren’t designed for living things.

entries.title: Cling — The Film That Smothers
entries.caption: FF · 57 / 60
entries.lore: Plastic against breath. Every clear wrap is somebody’s last room.

entries.title: Adorned — The Coat And Its Cost
entries.caption: FF · 58 / 60
entries.lore: Python at the throat, fur across the lap. Glamour stitched from two endings.

entries.title: Yolk — The Daily Cracking
entries.caption: FF · 59 / 60
entries.lore: An egg in a pan held to the ear. Listen long enough and the hens come through.

entries.title: Specimen — The Ear Wired Up
entries.caption: FF · 60 / 60
entries.lore: Strings taped to skin, ears propped open. A study in what’s done to be certain it works.
